children.name: text
children.label: Heading
children.default: Why leading retail brands chose us

children.name: tag
children.label: Heading level
children.help_text: For search engines and screen readers. Use H2 for a main section of the page. The heading always looks like the theme H2.
choices: H1 (main page heading, use once per page)

children.name: anchor_id
children.label: Anchor ID
children.help_text: Optional. Lets other links jump to this section.

name: slides
label: Slides
help_text: One slide per story or scenario, up to 9 (the most that fit on a phone). Place this module in a full-width row.

children.name: image
children.label: Image
children.help_text: Optional. A real store, stockroom or team photo, landscape, at least 1600 px wide. Alt text is required: describe the photo and name what HotWax does there. Without an image, the text uses the full width of the slide.

children.name: logo
children.label: Logo
children.help_text: Optional. Shown 36 px high. Use a PNG with a transparent background, trimmed to the logo.

children.name: subtitle
children.label: Subtitle
children.help_text: Optional short line above the title, such as the store count. No category: the logo already says who it is.

children.name: title
children.label: Title
children.help_text: Required. One short sentence: the outcome for the customer.

children.name: description
children.label: Description
children.help_text: Required. 2 to 3 sentences: what HotWax gives them and how it helps.

children.name: testimonial
children.label: Testimonial
children.help_text: Optional. The customer's published words, exactly. Quote marks are added for you. Hidden on phones.

children.name: link_text
children.label: Link text
children.help_text: Shown when the link below is set.

image.alt: Steve Madden store with shoes on tiered displays, inventory HotWax Commerce tracks in real time

default.subtitle: 150+ U.S. locations
default.title: Real-time inventory across 150+ U.S. locations.
default.description: On a legacy system, routing orders could take hours at peak. HotWax Commerce gave Steve Madden real-time inventory across stores and warehouses, then ship from store and same-day pickup.

image.alt: Mephisto Madison Avenue store with full shoe walls, store inventory HotWax Commerce keeps accurate on Shopify POS

default.subtitle: Sold in 80+ countries
default.title: Accurate store inventory on Shopify POS.
default.description: Moving from Retail Pro to Shopify POS, Mephisto's store teams receive purchase orders, transfer stock, and run cycle counts in HotWax Commerce, with every movement synced to Shopify and reported in one place.

image.alt: ADOC store sales floor with shoe displays, one of the stores HotWax Commerce routes orders to

default.subtitle: 200+ stores, 5 countries
default.title: One view of stock across five countries.
default.description: ADOC turns stores in El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, Nicaragua, and Costa Rica into fulfillment points. HotWax Commerce routes each order to the best store and powers same-day pickup on each country's Shopify site.
default.testimonial: …their unique focus on Shopify merchants like us makes them the right choice for our company.
default.author_role: Digital Experience and Customer Support Manager

image.alt: Perry Ellis store with shirt racks and a Perry Ellis counter, where store teams fulfill same-day pickup orders

default.subtitle: About 70 stores
default.title: Same-day pickup beyond Shopify's built-in local pickup.
default.description: Perry Ellis uses its stores as fulfillment centers. Shoppers see real-time store stock on product pages, save a favorite store, and pick up the same day, while store teams fulfill orders inside XStore.
default.testimonial: …the solutions can be implemented at a pace that aligns with the unique needs of our brands.

image.alt: gorjana store with a marble counter, gold logo and crystal chandelier, where store teams fulfill online orders in HotWax Commerce

default.subtitle: 130+ stores
default.title: Count, receive, and fulfill online orders in one place.
default.description: gorjana now has more than 130 stores. Store teams count inventory, receive stock, and fulfill online orders in HotWax Commerce, turning its stores into fulfillment hubs for online shoppers.

image.alt: Betsey Johnson dresses, handbags and shoes in a pink floral room, the new-collection drops HotWax Commerce releases to pre-order customers

default.subtitle: Bold fashion since 1978
default.title: Pre-orders released the moment new stock lands.
default.description: Betsey Johnson runs eCommerce and wholesale orders in HotWax Commerce, with one view of inventory across its warehouse and online channels. When a new collection arrives, pre-orders are allocated and released automatically, so drops ship on time.
